Attached: 2 images

A 17-minute check-in session isn't behavioral healthcare—it’s an assembly line. Forcing clinicians to conform to corporate "productivity models" sacrifices patient safety for spreadsheet metrics. You cannot assess complex trauma, catch critical warning signs, or build clinical trust in a quarter-hour. Quality care requires unhurried time and genuine presence. Stop running mental health care like a fast-food drive-thru.

#17min #productivity #BehavioralHealth #QualityCare #MentalHealth
